shared_ownership.query: with owned as materialized(select d.booking_id from booking_details d join accommodation_snapshot s on s.id=d.accommodation_snapshot_id join accommodations a on a.id=s.accommodation_id where a.partner_id=md5('partner')::uuid) select counts.*,revenue.revenue from(select count(b.id),sum(case when b.status='pending' then 1 else 0 end),sum(case when b.status='cancelled' then 1 else 0 end),sum(case when b.status='completed' then 1 else 0 end) from bookings b where b.id in(select booking_id from owned)) counts cross join(select coalesce(sum(p.amount),0) revenue from payments p where p.status='success' and p.booking_id in(select booking_id from owned)) revenue

union_scoped_aggregate.query: with owned as materialized(select d.booking_id from booking_details d join accommodation_snapshot s on s.id=d.accommodation_snapshot_id join accommodations a on a.id=s.accommodation_id where a.partner_id=md5('partner')::uuid) select sum(total),sum(pending),sum(cancelled),sum(completed),sum(received) from(select count(*) total,count(*) filter(where b.status='pending') pending,count(*) filter(where b.status='cancelled') cancelled,count(*) filter(where b.status='completed') completed,0::numeric received from bookings b where b.id in(select booking_id from owned) union all select 0,0,0,0,coalesce(sum(p.amount),0) from payments p where p.status='success' and p.booking_id in(select booking_id from owned)) x
